definitions.gloss: power distribution board; electrical panel; switchboard
definitions.explanation: A panel or board that distributes electrical power from a main source to various circuits within a building. Contains circuit breakers, switches, and fuses.

examples.japanese: {配電盤|はいでんばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ブレーカー→ブレーカー：07496_bureekaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: The breaker on the electrical panel tripped.

examples.japanese: {配電盤|はいでんばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The distribution board needs to be inspected regularly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{配電盤|はいでんばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When there's a power outage, first check the electrical panel.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{配電|はいでん}→配電：30069_haiden⟧ (power distribution) + ⟦{盤|ばん}→盤：18576_ban⟧ (board/panel). Found in every building, from homes to factories. Knowing this word is practical for everyday life in Japan, especially when dealing with electrical issues or reading building guides.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配電盤|はいでんばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧: inspection of the electrical panel
- {配電盤|はいでんばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧: replacement of the distribution board
- {配電盤|はいでんばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the electrical panel
- {主|しゅ}{配電盤|はいでんばん}: main distribution board

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{分電盤|ぶんでんばん}→分電盤：23334_bundenban⟧: sub-distribution panel; breaker box — the household version that divides circuits for rooms
- ⟦ブレーカー→ブレーカー：07496_bureekaa⟧: breaker; circuit breaker — individual safety switches within the panel
- {制御盤|せいぎょばん}: control panel — for controlling equipment, not just distributing power
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦メーター→メーター：23517_meetaa⟧: electric meter — measures usage, separate from the distribution board
